steps.title: Terms of services

items.label: Acceptance
choices: I agree to the Terms of Service

steps.description: Thank you for patronizing us. Please ensure you read these terms before you submit this form. By submitting a completed copy of this form, it is implied that you have read, understood and agreed to our terms of service. Where you are uncertain as to any of the terms, please feel free to get clarification from any member of our team. You may send a mail to info@lexpraxis.ng or call +234 706 544 3425. 1. By filling this form, you have retained our firm to register a company on your behalf and not a business name. Where you do not understand the difference between the two, please contact our team for clarification. 2. Our firm maintains a strict no refund policy on amount paid for our services. 3. We advise that this form be completed by you and not any of our team members as we will not be liable for any undesired outcome that may arise where you permit our team members to complete the form on your behalf. 4. Our service is performed strictly based on the information provided by you. We will therefore not be liable for any undesired outcome of our service that may occur based on the information provided by you. 5. The amount paid covers cost for one attempt at reservation of name and registration and does not cover additional incidents that may occur. 6. Where a name submitted for reservation is rejected by the relevant agency, and you have instructed us to reserve another name, such reservation and any other subsequent reservation will attract an additional amount of N1,000 (One thousand naira only) per attempt.
